metricDefinitions.publicDebt: latest general/federal government debt, % GDP; perimeter differs

US.summary: Largest direct valuation and capex channel; Treasury-market depth and refinancing costs determine whether an equity reset becomes systemic.

China.summary: Lower direct US-AI exposure, but property losses, LGFV debt and weak domestic demand create a second balance-sheet channel.

EU.summary: Lower direct AI concentration, but trade, banks and dollar funding transmit the first-round recession before any reallocation benefit.

Switzerland.summary: Low public debt and safe-haven demand cushion funding stress; franc appreciation and EU-market access constrain exports.
